Conditions

  • Orphic Favour Aura

    • The Prince of the Comet protects his champions. He and nearby allies gain resistance to ⁠Psychic and a +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

Features

  • Advanced Unarmoured Movement

    Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m / 20 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

  • Deflect Missiles

    Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

  • Evasion

    Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Ki-Empowered Strikes

    Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

  • Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike

    After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

  • Martial Arts: Deft Strikes

    Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

  • Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks

    Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Psionic Empowerment

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

  • Purity of Body

    You are Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned or affected by disease thanks to the purifying ki flowing through your meridians.

  • Slow Fall

    When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

  • Stillness of Mind

    If Charmed or Frightened, automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove them.

  • Unarmoured Defence

    Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class.

  • Unarmoured Movement

    Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

This page focuses on Orpheus's behavior during turn-based combat gameplay.

Attacks and actions

Githyanki form

Orpheus has the Orphic Favour Aura, giving all allies within 60ft/18m of him the  Orphic Favour condition.

In his githyanki form, Orpheus is a Way of the Four Elements Monk and has the following abilities:

 Dimension Door ( + 2 )

Teleport yourself and up to one adjacent ally to a place you can see. The ally cannot be larger than Medium.

Push the target back 6 m / 20 ft and knock it  Prone.

Conditions

  • Orphic Favour Aura

    • The Prince of the Comet protects his champions. He and nearby allies gain resistance to ⁠Psychic and a +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

  • Mind Flayer Form

    • Affected entity has embraced ceremorphosis and become a mind flayer.

  • Permanent Mind Sanctuary

    • While in combat, Mind Flayers can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

Features

  • Ability Drain

    Once per turn, when you make an Attack Roll, the attack reduces that target's corresponding Ability by 1. The reduced ability score cannot be decreased lower than 1.

  • Advanced Unarmoured Movement

    Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m / 20 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

  • Charm

    Can charm an attacking enemy, preventing further attacks until their next turn.

  • Cull the Weak

    When you bring a creature down to fewer hit points than your number of evolved illithid powers, it dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

  • Deflect Missiles

    Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

  • Evasion

    Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Favourable Beginnings

    First attack roll or ability check against any target gains proficiency bonus.

  • Ki-Empowered Strikes

    Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

  • Luck of the Far Realms

    Once per Long Rest, you can change a successful Attack Roll against a foe into a Critical Hit.

  • Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike

    After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

  • Martial Arts: Deft Strikes

    Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

  • Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks

    Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Permanent Mind Sanctuary

    You can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

  • Psionic Backlash

    When an enemy casts a spell, can use a reaction to deal 1d4 Psychic per spell level.

  • Psionic Dominance

    When an enemy within 18 m (60 ft) targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you can use your reaction to nullify the spell.

  • Psionic Empowerment

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

  • Purity of Body

    You are Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned or affected by disease thanks to the purifying ki flowing through your meridians.

  • Slow Fall

    When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

  • Stillness of Mind

    If Charmed or Frightened, automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove them.

  • Unarmoured Defence

    Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class.

  • Unarmoured Movement

    Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

If he undergoes ceremorphosis, Orpheus will have all the statistics (save his INT, WIS and CHA scores, which remain the same) and powers of a full-illithid. As well as gaining illithid passives, he will retain his original monk passives (but not abilities). The full-illithid ability Permanent Mind Sanctuary, allows Orpheus to use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
